title: Scalene A-triangle at rest: does pair-sum additivity hold without symmetry?
pitch: Three A particles at rest in a scalene triangle, pairs 5.42, 5.60, 6.26, run for T = 2. Every symmetric N = 3 and N = 4 test so far (P-0031, runs 007 and 008) used an equilateral triangle or a square. Those layouts cannot separate pair-sum additivity from a uniform rescaling of the pair table. Prediction: P-0031 as written (pair table summed pairwise, RK4, specular walls), no fitted parameters. P-0031 states symmetric layouts only, so this run tests its stated edge. Falsified if the judged RMSE/L exceeds 0.021 (3 x the 0.007 claim).
